2610.06725.title: BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models
2610.06725.paper_summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.
2610.06725.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）層在不成比例增加每個樣本計算的情況下提高了模型的容量。<lb/>然而，傳統的平面路由器可能導致專家利用不均衡，並將專家視為一個無結構的集合，其索引不具有拓撲意義。<lb/>我們介紹了{\bf BRANCH-MoE}，這是一種路由架構，將\(E\)個專家放置在深度為\(\log_2 E\)的二元決策樹的葉子上。<lb/>在每個內部節點，分支概率是基於到達該節點的流量加權平均分數。<lb/>這個平均值是使用指數移動平均來估計的，這促進了兩個子樹的利用，而不需要輔助的負載平衡損失。<lb/>我們展示了這個移動平均估計允許明確的噪聲滯後權衡。<lb/>我們證明了對於線性節點映射和對數凹到達分佈，這個機制防止了路由質量崩潰。<lb/>我們進一步確立，在固定路由器下，專家的執行頻率控制其隨機梯度收斂速率，並且在根附近的自信決策限制了跨設備通信，當專家按照樹前綴分配到設備時。<lb/>我們在Criteo點擊率預測、Forest Covertype、HIGGS和YearPredictionMSD上，使用\(E=16\)、top-\(4\)路由和五個隨機種子，對BRANCH-MoE進行了與Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3動態偏差、Skywork logit正規化和確定性哈希路由的評估。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，分層路由可以在保持任務質量和平衡利用的同時，誘導支持局部專家共同激活和減少通信的拓撲。
